sections.title: The neurosymbolic stack
sections.note: Mutable knowledge lives outside frozen weights; everything that touches a decision is verified; the Witness observes and never acts (INV-9).
layers: Knowledge — governed Plane H store (graph semantics planned)
Sākṣī — Witness: local implemented, distributed fabric prototype

cards.name: Canonical serialization
cards.desc: RFC 8785 JCS: one deterministic byte-stream per object across identity, signatures, manifests and witness records.

cards.name: Ed25519, ids, commitments, keystore
cards.desc: Strict small-order rejection, cofactored verification, canonical node/Being ids, hiding commitments, atomic 0600 encrypted keystore.

cards.name: VRF and threshold governance
cards.desc: ECVRF-EDWARDS25519-SHA512-TAI (RFC 9381) pinned to all three official B.3 vectors, with validate_key fail-closed checks; naive m-of-n multisig verification (aggregate FROST signing deferred).

cards.name: Merkle trees
cards.desc: Legacy padding tree plus RFC 6962 inclusion and consistency proofs, property-tested across tree shapes and forgery cases.

cards.name: Witness chain
cards.desc: Hash-chained, Ed25519-signed, persist-before-expose append under a chain-internal lock, offline replay and legacy-log verification.

cards.name: Typed boundary and durability
cards.desc: Fail-closed typed envelopes; fsynced journals, torn-tail repair and reload-time re-verification.

cards.name: External anchoring
cards.desc: Durable receipt log with local, peer-quorum and OTS-calendar backends. OTS is proof custody; standard tooling verifies the stored calendar proof.

cards.name: Monero root-as-spend-key anchor
cards.desc: The witness root deterministically becomes a Monero address; a dust payment timestamps the binding without storing the root in tx_extra.

cards.name: Smriti — continuity and memory
cards.desc: Core/archival memory, verified recall, signed export/import, read-only thinking view and journal reconstruction.

cards.name: Viveka — discernment and deliberation
cards.desc: Deterministic graphs, conditional routing, checkpoints, visible rollback, bounded loops and containment-aware executive steps.

cards.name: Karma — governed action
cards.desc: Witnessed intent/outcome, path confinement, rlimits, streaming flood-kill, deterministic child environment. Reference sandbox, not hardened isolation.

cards.name: BeingRuntime
cards.desc: One long-lived composition owning one identity, ONE witness chain, Smriti, Plane H, Viveka, Router, Karma and Containment. Closes the v0.5.2 audit composition gap.

cards.name: Decision lifecycle
cards.desc: RECEIVED → GROUNDED → PLANNED → GENERATED → VERIFIED → AUTHORIZED → ACTED → RECORDED with REFUSED / FAILED / FATE_UNKNOWN / CONTAINED branches; every transition witnessed then journaled.

cards.name: Semantic recovery
cards.desc: After restart every trace is rebuilt from the durable journal; an orphaned Karma intent closes as FATE_UNKNOWN — the system that does not know says so.

cards.name: POST /v1/tasks
cards.desc: Returns a full DecisionTrace, not a raw completion: states, citations, plan hash, generator and panel provenance, containment decision, action receipt, witness span.

cards.name: Node and Being identity
cards.desc: Persistent keystores, genesis binding, boot verification and migration consent. The daemon fails closed on signer/witness mismatch.

cards.name: Reputation §9.9 and sealed verdicts
cards.desc: Decay, Bayesian shrinkage, slashing and signed context-bound verdict envelopes with replay refusal.

cards.name: Governed Plane H
cards.desc: Signed proposals, namespace ACL, transactional witness-bound append, supersede/redact, root-preserving redaction. Retrieval remains a token-overlap baseline; not yet a semantic knowledge graph.

cards.name: Witness replication and recovery
cards.desc: Signed RFC 6962 roots, quorum receipts, consistency proofs, segment coverage, divergence evidence and restore-and-resume against an anchored root.

cards.name: Cross-chain entanglement
cards.desc: Recipient-root cross-links, PEER_ROOT checkpoints and issuance inclusion proofs. Attribution is cryptographic only under the documented honest/anchored issuer assumption.

cards.name: IFF — friend or foe
cards.desc: Durable peer registry, steward admission, key pinning and replay-protected signed requests, layered under TLS/mTLS transport.

cards.name: Provenance and diversity
cards.desc: Signed immutable manifests and correlation-constrained panel selection. Unknown provenance counts as correlated; short panels fail honest.

cards.name: Weight attestation
cards.desc: Streamed artifact measurement, signed DeploymentManifest, durable store and daemon boot gate. Proves operator measurement, not engine memory.

cards.name: Unified router
cards.desc: Registry-aware champion routing, signed ROUTE records and diversity-constrained verifier panels — now driven by the BeingRuntime lifecycle as well as usable as a library.

cards.name: Adversarial challenge round
cards.desc: VRF sortition (transcript-bound, unbiasable seats), blind commit-reveal verdicts, deadline/abstention semantics and offline-verifiable fraud proofs that slash via the registry — now driven over mTLS via /challenge/* as well as in-process.

cards.name: Peer cross-verification loop
cards.desc: Remote teacher-forcing score, offline peer-Witness re-audit and registry feedback. The challenge round now runs across the network (core/challenge.py + /challenge/* endpoints).

cards.name: Containment — Article 25
cards.desc: Seven executive scopes, provisional containment, reversal, initiator liability, slashing, rehabilitation and Steward-review gate. Steward keys and ballots remain absent.

cards.name: Tier-1 trust node daemon
cards.desc: Inference/scoring, Witness export, replication, entanglement, attestation, anchoring, peers, containment, the Being task lifecycle, per-identity rate limiting, role-based authorization, cert revocation, /healthz and /metrics, and the networked challenge round — all over TLS/mTLS.

cards.name: Engine adapters
cards.desc: Generation plus teacher-forcing score with mock and live acceptance seams. Real GPU acceptance and operational profiles remain pending (operator-run gate).

cards.name: NECS v0.1 + harness
cards.desc: Conformance specification and harness under Apache-2.0, preserving vendor-neutral adoption.

cards.name: Acceptance and CI
cards.desc: Acceptance functions across unit, integration, conformance, adversarial and legacy groups; CI matrix targets Python 3.10-3.12; docs drift is CI-checked.

cards.name: Retired M1-M5 lineage
cards.desc: Frozen legacy code retained for auditability and migration coverage.

sections.title: Not yet in the codebase
sections.note: Designed in the Whitepaper and Charter — and deliberately absent from the code today. Naming the absence is part of the architecture.

cards.name: Plane B canary lifecycle
cards.desc: Secret reserve, expiry and rotation, commit-reveal, contamination detection, work classes and fraud proofs.

cards.name: Knowledge graph / ontology semantics
cards.desc: Typed entities and relations, ontology versioning, graph provenance, deterministic query contracts and verified graph mutation above the governed Plane H store.

cards.name: TEE / runtime attestation
cards.desc: Evidence that the serving process loaded the measured model and adapter bytes into the executing memory boundary.

cards.name: DIIP — governed self-improvement
cards.desc: Proposals, bonds, shadow execution, quorum, time-lock, rollback and circuit breaker. It should govern a stable runtime, not become the mechanism that invents one.

cards.name: Training federation
cards.desc: Specialization pipeline, DiLoCo/PRIME-class federation and a multi-jurisdiction training/Witness topology.

cards.name: Human governance layer
cards.desc: Being Registry, guardian representation, Digital Majority Test, economic reserve, Steward Collegium keys, ballots, veto, succession and refusal policy.

honest_sentence: v0.4.1 closed the identity gap. v0.5-dev5 closed the cryptographic boundary. v0.5-dev6 made replication sound. v0.5.1 closed P1 mechanisms. v0.5.2 added the Monero anchor. v0.5.3 closed the COMPOSITION GAP: one BeingRuntime drives every organ through one witnessed lifecycle over one identity, and POST /v1/tasks returns the full DecisionTrace — including the honest endings REFUSED, FAILED, FATE_UNKNOWN and CONTAINED. v0.5.4 made verification ADVERSARIAL: RFC 9381 ECVRF (vector-pinned) drives transcript-bound panel sortition nobody can grind; verdicts are sealed before any are shown; silence and fraud become witnessed, offline-verifiable evidence; and the daemon holds its first operational boundary — per-identity rate limiting whose systematic abuse is itself witnessed. v0.5.5 is the SECURITY-ALPHA: role-based authorization (default-deny, longest-prefix), certificate revocation that beats identity, /healthz + /metrics, the challenge round carried over mTLS, a production PKI with an offline root, optional TPM-sealed keystores, a hardened systemd unit and an operator runbook — the kit to stand up testnet-0 on Ubuntu.

Said plainly: authorization is transport-role based (peer/admin/anonymous from the mTLS CN), not yet capability- or steward-ballot based; certificate revocation is serial-list based; Karma is still a reference sandbox, not hardened isolation; the knowledge store is retrieval-baseline, not a knowledge graph; and DIIP remains deliberately absent. This is an alpha to operate among known operators, not to expose to untrusted load.
